div.para: The entire diagram represents the product \(6(3+4)\). The upper half represents \(6 \cdot 3\) while the lower half represents \(6 \cdot 4\).

list.item: Explain why the diagram shows that \(6(3+4)=6 \cdot 3+6 \cdot 4\).
Draw a diagram to show that \(5(x + 2) = 5x + 10\).

problem.para: Write down your answer, then select the solution button to compare your work.

solution.para: Diagrams will vary, but should show a large rectangle with two sub-rectangles, with one sub-rectangle representing \(5 \cdot x\), and the other representing \(5 \cdot 2\). For example:

image.alt: A RECTANGLE DIVIDED INTO TWO SMALLER RECTANGLES. THE LENGTH OF THE RECTANGLE IS 5, THE WIDTH OF ONE SMALLER RECTANGLE IS X, AND THE WIDTH OF THE OTHER SMALLER RECTANGLE IS 2.
